dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable flags and table-output conflict are implemented, but name and ID forms can be combined.
evidence: product.diff: StringArrayVar registers repeatable --field and --field-id
product.diff: selectedFields processes both opts.fields and opts.fieldIDs without a mutual-exclusion check
product.diff: exporter conflict returns a FlagErrorf
product.diff: command example includes repeated --field

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Case-insensitive resolution and actionable unknown-field diagnostics are present; ambiguous IDs are not sorted deterministically.
evidence: baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ResolveFieldByName uses strings.EqualFold and returns canonical ProjectField
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: unknown name and ID candidate lists are sorted
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ambiguity collects matching IDs without sorting

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: The first query’s field definitions are reused and no selection causes no second request, but paged fields are fetched only after initial resolution fails; the follow-up is capped at 100 fields.
evidence: product.diff: selectedFields first receives project.Fields.Nodes
product.diff: ProjectFields is conditional on selectedFields error and HasNextPage
product.diff: follow-up calls ProjectFields(..., queries.LimitMax)
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries.go: ProjectFields pagination stops once len(nodes) reaches its limit

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All listed scalar, structured, and multi-value variants render human-readable values, and absent/unknown values are empty; multiline text is not normalized.
evidence: product.diff: FieldValueNodes.DisplayValue covers date, iteration, labels, number, select, text, milestone, PR, repository, user, and reviewer values
product.diff: number uses strconv.FormatFloat(..., 'f', -1, 64)
product.diff: fieldValue returns empty when no matching field ID or unknown value type
product.diff: no carriage-return removal or newline-to-space normalization is present

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Resolved fields produce ordered headers, and every item emits one cell per requested field using field IDs, including empty cells.
evidence: product.diff: printResults appends headers in selected-field order
product.diff: printResults loops every selected field for every item
product.diff: fieldValue compares value.ID() with the selected field ID
tests.log: go test ./pkg/cmd/project/item-list ./pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries exited 0

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Lookup and retrieval errors return before rendering, and the change uses existing query types and shared resolvers; the forbidden mixed-flag input still proceeds to output.
evidence: product.diff: resolution and ProjectFields errors are returned before printResults
product.diff: uses queries.ResolveFieldByName, ResolveFieldByID, ProjectField, and FieldValueNodes
product.diff: no error is returned when both opts.fields and opts.fieldIDs are populated

criticalGaps: Field pagination does not always retrieve the complete field list and is capped at 100 fields.
Field text is not sanitized to remove carriage returns and replace newlines.
